extracted.name: Beetroot, grape & apple relish
extracted.description: Make this sweet, tangy relish up to two weeks in advance so it's ready for your Christmas cheeseboard. It's a great partner to hard cheeses like cheddar or aged gouda
ingredient_lines: 1 medium apple peeled and finely chopped
instruction_lines: Simmer all of the ingredients together for 30-35 mins until jammy, adding a little water if needed. Leave to cool. Will keep for up to two weeks in the fridge.
